transcript.content: Hello. I'm glad you're here today. What brings you in to see me?
I'm here because I've been really struggling to cope and feeling completely overwhelmed for the last five months. It feels like the stress has just become too much for me to handle on my own.
Did these feelings of being overwhelmed start after a specific stressful event or a major life change that happened around five months ago?

Yes, they did. It all started about five months ago right after I went through a difficult breakup and had to move out of my apartment. The stress from those sudden changes hit me almost immediately, and I've been struggling ever since.
Along with feeling overwhelmed, have you been experiencing a persistently low mood, or a loss of interest in things you normally enjoy?

Yes, my mood has been incredibly low, and I just don't care about the things I used to love anymore. I find myself crying a lot lately and feeling completely hopeless about the future. It just feels like I'm stuck in a dark place and can't get out.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep patterns, appetite, or energy levels since all of this started?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. My energy levels seem relatively normal too, despite how down I've been feeling.
Have you found it harder to concentrate, focus on your work or daily tasks, or make decisions since all of this started?
To be honest, I haven't really noticed any major issues with my concentration or focus. My ability to make decisions seems pretty much the same as it was before all of this happened.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, or feeling excessively guilty or blaming yourself for things that aren't your fault?
No, I haven't really been feeling worthless or excessively guilty. I don't blame myself for the breakup or how things turned out, I'm just feeling incredibly down about the whole situation.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or feelings that you would be better off dead?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or felt like I would be better off dead. Even though I feel incredibly down and hopeless about the future, I don't want to harm myself at all.
How have these feelings and the stress from the breakup affected your daily life, such as your work, relationships, or social activities?

The stress has really made me withdraw socially, and I've been avoiding my friends and staying home a lot more. I just don't have the energy or desire to interact with anyone right now, so I've completely pulled back from social activities.
Have you noticed if you are moving or speaking much slower than usual, or conversely, feeling unusually restless and unable to sit still?
I haven't really noticed myself speaking or moving any slower than usual. I also haven't felt unusually restless or had any trouble sitting still.
